title: Usage queue: SQS queue, dead-letter queue and alarm, consumer, and a registry-generated queue policy
description: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md, 'How apps send usage'. Prospectus IaC creates the queue, DLQ with alarm, and a consumer that writes batches to the ledger and quota, idempotent by operation ID. Queue policy lets each registered product's role send and nothing else, generated from the product registry. New persistent permissions: owner approval required before deploy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live in production 2026-11-09 (#146): queues and dead-letter queues for babulus, cyclotron, papyrus-dataparade, papyrus-p-apyr-us and papyrus-pilobol-us. The once-a-minute drain runs cleanly with nothing queued yet. Apps start sending when they adopt the sender (kanbus-1f0c86 and the other adoption tasks).
